name: json2dir-purescript
description: PureScript compiled to JavaScript (spago bundle), run on Node.js; core libraries only, hand-written JSON parser and strict UTF-8 decoder, tiny node:fs FFI
build: cd {src} && export PATH={runtimes}/purescript-0.15.16/purescript:{runtimes}/node-v24.21.0/bin:$PATH npm_config_cache={runtimes}/purescript-0.15.16/npm-cache XDG_CACHE_HOME={runtimes}/purescript-0.15.16/cache && { [ -d node_modules ] || npm ci --no-audit --no-fund; } && npx spago bundle
